country_decisions: CFG-IDN-001: national identity eligibility and the issuing authority (the identity slot, shipped empty).
CFG-IDN-002: identifier generation, uniqueness and replacement rules, and credential types and validity (none ship).
CFG-IDN-003: the verification responses and the recipients permitted (identity.verify, each caller and purpose approved by two officials).
CFG-IDN-004: biometric authorisation, if any, and its security requirements: legal review first (plan I11); none ships.

library.title: Apply for a national identity
library.intro: Apply to be enrolled in the national identity register. Give your names and date of birth as your evidence shows them and attach that evidence. The identity authority checks your eligibility and evidence; nothing is created from another record without a decision.
library.filled_by: The person, a parent or guardian for a child, or an authorised representative: online, at an office or on paper.
library.authority: The identity authority the nation names for the identity slot of the deployment profile (authorityFor('identity')). Never a ministry by name.

policies.access.read_rule: canReadIdentity() in lib/auth/roles.ts: the identity authority's officials; auditors with a purpose; every read and search in the access log
policies.access.others: Other institutions learn only a verification result through identity.verify, never the record

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it
No field scores a person, a household, a credential, an employer or an application: no risk, credibility, propensity or match score exists in the contract or its procedure
deviations.why: Directions §15.6 and §15.7; supplement Part 15: a risk score alone cannot determine loss of essential support; field series Part 4 §4.4: no opaque risk scores.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Immigration and Customs ("never a score"); lib/social/procedures.ts refuses a suspension whose grounds rest on a score

deviations.what: The identity authority is the institution the nation names for the identity slot of the deployment profile, never a ministry by name; until it is named no case opens
deviations.why: Who is legally responsible comes from the deployment profile (directions §3; CFG-IDN-001).

deviations.what: No biometric field, template, match or score: a photograph is a document of the case (an image), and no biometric template is made or stored
deviations.why: Field series Part 4 §3.4: biometric collection is not a default; CFG-IDN-004 (biometric authorisation) needs the nation's law and an independent legal review first (plan I11).
deviations.rule: lib/identity/register.ts and lib/passports/register.ts hold no biometric data; app/scripts/requirements/catalogue.py PROHIBITED_FIELD

quotes: Owns: credential issuance, status, revocation, verification events and identity-resolution cases.
Does not automatically own the underlying birth or court records.

platform.how: Credentials with issuance, status and revocation, verification through identity.verify and resolution determinations; the civil register is linked by reference only and never changed

quotes: National identity administration is separate from civil registration.

A civil event may support an identity application, but it must not automatically create, merge, or invalidate a national identity unless an explicitly configured legal rule authorizes the specific transition.

platform.how: A civil register entry is linked only with its basis; enrolment, merge or invalidation happens only by an identity decision, never from a civil event

quotes: Sensitive values such as full identity numbers should be masked by default in staff interfaces, search results, logs, exports, and notifications.
Full values should appear only where the user's role, purpose, and case authorization permit them.

platform.how: maskNumber() and listedIdentity(): numbers masked in staff lists; the full record only under canReadIdentity(), with a purpose for a name search, every read logged

quotes: The permitted response vocabulary must be configured to match the jurisdiction's law and service contract.
A failed lookup must not be treated as proof that a person does not exist, lacks citizenship, or is ineligible for a service.

platform.how: VERIFY_RESULTS and VERIFY_MEANING: verified, not_verified, unable_to_verify, additional_review_required; not_verified states that it is not proof of non-existence or ineligibility

quotes: A requesting institution should normally receive only the result needed for its lawful purpose, not the underlying civil or identity record.
A biometric match must not itself make an adverse legal decision.
